purpose: Phase-6A FUNCTIONAL-EVIDENCE registry. Evidence records (with verification_status) and prediction records for the functional edges / cellular-state responses. Consumed READ-ONLY. No functional claim is EXPERIMENTAL unless a primary source is VERIFIED_IN_FROZEN_PACKAGE (none is, for functional response). No enzyme kinetics, ROS/GSH/cytokine concentration, adhesion %, membrane potential, activity %, half-life, or dose-response value is fabricated.

integrity_rules.no_experimental_without_verified_referen: No functional edge is EXPERIMENTAL_* unless its reference is VERIFIED_IN_FROZEN_PACKAGE (none is).
integrity_rules.cell_fate_not_evaluated: Cell-fate evidence stays NOT_EVALUATED; no apoptosis/caspase/cytochrome-c/AIF/necrosis record exists.
integrity_rules.no_fabricated_values: No enzyme kinetics, ROS/GSH/cytokine concentration, adhesion %, membrane potential, activity %, half-life, or dose-response value; unavailable = NOT_REPORTED.
